final.role: Corrigir mojibake e problemas de codificacao em texto das notas antes de indexar ou sincronizar
final.evidence: ftfy can fix mojibake (encoding mix-ups), by detecting patterns of characters that were clearly meant to be UTF-8 but were decoded as something else. Apache license.
